ideas.pitch: An AI-powered copy-trading and strategy execution platform tailored for perpetual decentralized exchanges, allowing students to backtest and deploy automated trading scripts within 47 hours.
ideas.title: GatorPerp CopyTrader
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of ClashX by combining automated trading strategies with a sleek interface for decentralized perpetuals.

ideas.pitch: A micropayment gateway using HTTP 402 protocol to monetize real-time student housing and campus event data feeds using Solana blockchain microtransactions.
ideas.title: SolanaCampus Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact architectural pattern of x402-Triton-Gateway by implementing HTTP 402 payment required standards for high-frequency data access.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk detection and AML investigation platform using LightGBM and graph intelligence to flag suspicious student-run micro-transactions and wallet flows.
ideas.title: Gator AML Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of Bito by using graph intelligence and machine learning to solve financial compliance and risk detection problems.

ideas.pitch: A localized real estate valuation engine powered by gradient boosted regression and neural networks trained on historical Alachua County property and student housing listings.
ideas.title: Gainesville Rental Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven regression and GBR techniques to a localized dataset, directly replicating the House_Price_Prediction_Hackathon winning methodology.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that uses USDC escrow on Base to coordinate and pay student freelancers for campus delivery and task automation.
